scope: Read-only research for Part 2 of issue #339. No Engine calculations were run and no files were edited.

source.citation: Ma'mun et al. (2005), Table 2, printed p. 632
source.title: Solubility of carbon dioxide in 30 mass % monoethanolamine and 50 mass % methyldiethanolamine solutions

conditions.MEA: 30 mass%; papers express this as mole fraction about 0.11

row_set.match: Exact complete set, including the two distinct measurements at loading 0.3424
row_set.evidence: The source's 19 Table 2 pairs match the 19 ordered rows in Mamun_2005_VLE.csv and the 19 canonical Part I pressure targets. Baygi Table 5 reports n=19 and the exact pressure/loading endpoints; Najafloo Table 4 lists the same conditions and Table 5 reports n=19; Zhang Table 9 reports n=19 at 393 K with rounded ranges. The matching count, endpoints, and complete original source table establish the same set; this is not inferred from ranges alone.

comparison.role: Predicted; authors state no ternary VLE regression
Predicted; pure-MEA parameters were fitted, while the ternary CO2–MEA interaction was set to zero
comparison.locator: Table 5; Ma'mun et al. row; methods §§3.1–3.3

comparison.calculation: Mean of the 19 absolute row-wise relative pressure errors in adoption-297/paper-evidence/state-targets.csv, using the same denominator as the published AARD.

mamun_2005_exact_match.common_deviation_definition: 100/n × Σ |pCO2,calc − pCO2,exp| / pCO2,exp. Baygi Table 5 gives this explicitly in its footnote; Zhang Table 9 labels the quantity average relative deviation |δY/Y|. Najafloo Table 5 and §3.3 report pressure AAD% but define neither averaging formula nor denominator. Equivalence of Najafloo AAD% to this formula is inferred, not verified; Eq. 2 is the pure-component fitting objective.

classification_notes.Neumann2022: Excluded as an MEA model: the indexed paper is Thermodynamic Properties of Methyl Diethanolamine, an MDEA pure-fluid model, not a reactive MEA model.
classification_notes.Akula2021: Excluded from the thermodynamic-property model inventory: the available record is a process-model paper and supplement, not a standalone MEA equilibrium-property model.
classification_notes.B\u00f6ttinger2008: Relevant Pitzer/speciation model with six coefficients in two MEA reaction laws, but no aggregate MEA deviation was found; its VLE comparisons use earlier VLE-fitted interactions.

source_gaps: Aronu 2011: one unambiguous total fitted-parameter count and exact row identities for the Part I overlap were not established.
Hessen 2010: a source-specific Ma'mun deviation and a single fitted-parameter total were not located.

Téllez-Arredondo 2013: its differing temperature limits need resolution from exact paper data/table context before using 12.5% as a strictly comparable score; exact sample count for that aggregate is not reported in the inspected table.
Akula 2023: n for the reported 40.5% restricted 30 wt% MAPE subset is not stated, preventing an exact row-for-row comparison.
Pakravesh 2025: SI is available from the publisher, but its pure-MEA density/Cp content does not establish overlap with Part I’s loaded-state data.

No model-agreement scores here establish physical validation. They are published model-to-measurement deviations or retained fixed-parameter comparisons; source uncertainty and between-source disagreement remain separate limits.
